ety.text: Probably Inherited from Sauraseni Prakrit *𑀡𑀺𑀪𑀼𑀟 (*ṇibhuḍa), 𑀡𑀺𑀪𑀼𑀅 (ṇibhua), from Sanskrit निभृत (nibhṛta, “borne down”).

s.g: to revive, to resurrect, to rejuvenate

ety.text: Hindi verb set पुतना (putnā) पोतना (potnā) Inherited from Prakrit 𑀧𑁄𑀢𑁆𑀢 (pŏtta).
Borrowed from Sanskrit प्रकट (prakaṭa). Related to प्रकृत (prakŕt), निकट (nikaṭ, “near”), विकट (vikaṭ, “huge”), and संकट (saṅkaṭ, “narrow”).
Borrowed from Sanskrit प्रौढत्व (prauḍhatva). Equal to प्रौढ़ (prauṛh) + -त्व (-tva).
